environmentSources.MAIL_FROM: Development sender locally or verified hosted sender
environmentSources.MAIL_PROVIDER: Development outbox locally or selected hosted email provider
environmentSources.APP_ORIGIN: Canonical application origin from local installer or owner deployment receipt
environmentSources.CONNECTION_ENCRYPTION_KEY: Private installation secret generated by setup; encrypts destination credentials
environmentSources.MAIL_PROVIDER_API_KEY: Private hosted email credential saved through the setup manifest

install.effects: Install frozen dependencies; no application or provider effect.

setup.effects: Validate manifest answers, retain private settings and owner, build and migrate locally, request outbox sign-in returning to /setup, then stop the temporary app.

dev.effects: Serve the local application with HMR and ordinary outbox sign-in; stop with dev --stop.

preview.effects: Serve the production output locally with ordinary outbox sign-in; stop with preview --stop.

build.effects: Build the real Worker and assets without private local bindings.

verify.effects: Run product typechecks, tests, browser journeys, command contract, copy checks, recursive onboarding suite and local data roundtrip.

reset.effects: With explicit confirmation remove only inventoried local state, owner, outbox, private settings and drafts. Preserve source, dependencies, exports and deployment receipts.

deploy.effects: Build and validate the owner-account deployment plan; dry-run makes zero provider calls. A real deployment requires declared owner credentials.

export.effects: Archive all supported local DB and FILES data using Base portability; credentials and automatic effect authority are excluded or held. Remote transfer is unsupported.

import.effects: Validate integrity and atomically restore into an empty local installation with explicit confirmation. Recompute generated columns; do not resume effects.

release.effects: Build the existing local source release and receipt; never push or deploy.

outbox.effects: Print the running local development outbox URL; request a fresh sign-in only with explicit owner email.

doctor.effects: Read-only local prerequisites and configuration diagnostics; no provider calls.

describe.effects: Read-only commands, flags, effects and pins.

check.effects: Read-only structural command-contract check; works without dependencies or credentials.
